# Evidence and research integrity checklist

## Change summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Evidence

- Source / DOI / persistent URL:
- Publication date:
- Statistical reference period:
- Geographic and statistical universe:
- Unit and precision:
- Evidence type: observed / administrative / official estimate / derived / proxy / metadata

## Comparability

Explain whether this changes a methodology, source family, territorial definition, unit, historical vintage or release boundary.

## Checklist

- [ ] The affected files/rows/fields are identified.
- [ ] Missing observations were not silently interpolated or extrapolated.
- [ ] Historical observations were not silently overwritten by a newer vintage.
- [ ] Observed values, proxies and derived indicators remain distinguishable.
- [ ] Source-specific attribution and reuse conditions were preserved.
- [ ] Documentation, source registry and/or changelog were updated where needed.
- [ ] A material change to published results will be handled through an appropriate versioned release.
